minutes.headline: Sewer Commission approved a 10% rate increase budget for FY21 over one member's objection, after sharp dispute over Leominster costs.
minutes.summary: The remote meeting finalized the pump station maintenance RFP, tabled the generator RFP, and discussed small water's contract termination and legal notice. The commission debated the FY21 budget at length, with a member arguing for deferring any rate increase to November, and then a motion to accept a 10% increase budget was made and seconded. It also postponed the irrigation meter conversion deadline, reviewed a 1170 Mass Ave agreement, and approved two sets of minutes.

public_comment.topic: Chair called for public comment; no comment was offered.

votes.motion: Postpone discussion of the generator RFP until the next meeting.
Accept the FY21 budget with a 10% increase.
Postpone the due date for irrigation meter changeover to September 1st.
Accept the minutes from the earlier meeting with the changes discussed.
Approve the minutes of April 14 with the correction.
Adjourn the April 28th Sewer Commission meeting.

what_happened.line: A motion to accept the FY21 sewer budget with a rate increase was made and seconded, but the count was not audible, so the outcome is not confirmed.
The budget debate centered on whether the budget carries Leominster outflow charges; one member argued it carries nothing for them.
The commission agreed to send the pump station maintenance RFP out as written, with a markup sheet and added wording such as a simulated power-failure generator test.
A motion to postpone the generator RFP to the next meeting was taken; the result was not audible, and the topic is listed as tabled.
The irrigation meter changeover deadline was moved to September 1, and irrigation meter participants will be invoiced for the fee the billing system failed to apply.

why_it_matters: The sewer rate set in this budget flows into resident and business sewer bills, and the debate shows the budget may not yet cover Leominster and Fitchburg charges, which could raise rates later.
Owners with irrigation meters may receive a mailed invoice for a fee that was budgeted but never billed.
watch_next: Next meeting May 12 at 4 p.m., remote: the generator RFP and the corrected 1170 Mass Ave agreement are expected to return.
The minutes do not record the FY21 budget vote result; check the next minutes or the recording for it.
